page.overview:
What is Celebi?

Celebi is small, fairy-like/insectoid Pokémon. Its body is pale yellowish green and bright green. It has long arms, small paws, a round, gracefully plump body, and short, thin legs with rounded feet. Its round head is shaped similarly to a flower bulb, extended upward in a left stroke that curls. Celebi's round, bright teal-blue eyes, bordered by black markings, are rather large, compensating most of its face, and it has a small mouth. Extending from its round head are two small, slightly curled, stringy antennae with teal tips. From its upper-back, two translucent white moth-like wings that are short and small sprout, extending only halfway up its arm length. It flutters its wings to fly, but levitates most of the time as well using its psychic powers.

Celebi is a mysterious and elusive Pokémon, very rarely seen by humans. It is said to come from the future, resides and conceals itself in deep forests, and often travels through time with its unique ability. It acts as a childlike and benevolent protector of the forest in which it lives. It has healing abilities in which it generously restores both plants and injured animals, even the wounds of humans that it trusts. It allows vegetation, such as grass and trees, to flourish.

As shown in both games, and the anime, it is very playful, joyful, and friendly toward those it gains trust with, and is loved by both Pokémon and people. According to legends about this Pokémon, is said by humans that an appearance of a Celebi means that a bright future is ahead.

Celebi's most notable ability is its time-traveling powers, which it often uses. It also possesses healing powers, and the ability to restore plantlife and let it flourish within the forest in which it protects. It has the power to guard forests, and the Pokémon that reside within.
